name: task-create-base-branch-seed
title: Harden task.py create: base-branch seed and description requirement
description: task_store.py:296 records the branch the author is standing on as a new task's base_branch, but the field means the branch a future pull request will target. Those coincide only when a task is created from the default branch, and the SD flow gives every task scaffold its own branch by convention -- a diff spanning more than one Trellis task directory only warns, it does not fail, so the habit is a nudge rather than a forcing function. A survey of active records against origin/main on 2026-08-07 shows 45 of 51 name main and six name a feature branch, all six root tasks and five of them naming a branch with no surviving ref; four of those five share one branch. The same survey on 2026-08-06 found only two exceptions, one merged on 2026-07-30 that went unnoticed for a week, so the set is growing and must be re-run at implementation time rather than read from any record. The deterministic gate does not catch it: the preflight requires base_branch to be non-empty and to differ from branch, but a fresh record has branch null, and the rule constraining base_branch to a parent's target applies only to child tasks. PR #342 reached a paid Copilot round with the wrong value after passing preflight with 0 failures.
